items.title: Codex policy boundary remains locally gated across Guardian, approvals and MCP/tool behavior
items.summary: Codex advanced 195 commits with Guardian/misalignment, command-approval, MCP and agent-role/tool behavior changes while ctrl@main remained fixed and no executable local compatibility witness was available.
items.localContractImpact: Keep the blocking gate open before adopting current Codex policy semantics into spec/.codex or controller assumptions.

observations.observation: The admitted-head-to-current delta includes Guardian/misalignment policy, command-execution approval, MCP-facing and agent-role/tool changes; subject policy contracts did not change and compatibility was not executed.

claims.text: Current Codex policy behavior cannot be treated as locally compatible until the declared local gate is executed.

items.title: Codex app-server protocol and generated schema projection advanced materially
items.summary: The 195-commit delta modifies protocol source and generated JSON/TypeScript schemas across thread items/turns/revert/realtime, approvals, Guardian, error and response-usage surfaces.
items.localContractImpact: Reconcile local app-server/config/transport projections before treating current main as protocol-compatible.

observations.observation: ClientRequest, ServerNotification, v2 thread/realtime/approval types and their generated schemas changed together between the admitted and current heads.

claims.text: The declared Codex protocol/schema/runtime projection differs materially from the previous admitted baseline.

items.title: Weaver tightened v2 attribute-reference validation
items.summary: Weaver now disallows stability and deprecated metadata on v2 attribute references, changing the projected semantic-interface validation substrate.
items.localContractImpact: Keep DiagnosticPacket realization compatible with the current Weaver registry rules while preserving CUE as semantic and qualification authority; do not block until a repo-backed consumer/gate exists.

observations.observation: Current Weaver main disallows stability and deprecated metadata on v2 attribute refs.

claims.text: The projected DiagnosticPacket interface-validation implementation has a new compatibility constraint without acquiring qualification authority.

items.title: Ruff analyzer/linter rule model continued evolving
items.summary: Ruff main advanced with rule-code handling changes. No contradictory CPython evidence or repo-backed qualification dependency was established.
items.localContractImpact: Retain as analyzer forecast evidence only.

observations.observation: Current tip allows rules without codes; this remains analyzer behavior rather than CPython truth.

claims.text: The analyzer forecast changed without establishing a ctrl qualification change.

items.title: GenAI validation scenarios observe additional system and legacy events
items.summary: After dependency maintenance, the agent-framework scenario records gen_ai.system plus legacy message/choice events. This is provider/semantic-convention observation evidence, not qualification.
items.localContractImpact: Preserve event-shape awareness for future instrumentation consumers; no current blocking consumer was established.

observations.observation: Current validation report includes gen_ai.system and legacy gen_ai message/choice events for agent-framework-core 1.15.0.

claims.text: Observed GenAI event output changed without establishing ctrl semantic or qualification authority.

items.title: OTel-Arrow transform completion suppresses empty semantic outputs
items.summary: The transform processor now forwards only non-empty semantic telemetry, ACKs fully filtered inputs locally, and preserves routed-output completion tracking.
items.localContractImpact: Record the dataflow/transport behavior while keeping it below ctrl evidence interpretation and qualification authority.

observations.observation: Fully filtered transform inputs no longer emit empty PData; completion/ACK semantics are handled locally or by non-empty routed outputs.

claims.text: OTel-Arrow dataflow completion behavior changed without adding semantic facts or a qualification verdict.
